```
Authenticate with the platform.

There are two ways to authenticate:

1. Browser login (OAuth): Opens your browser to complete authentication.
   Note: This requires the OAuth app to have a localhost callback URL configured.

2. API key: Create an API key in the dashboard (Settings > API Keys) and use
   it with the --token flag. This is the recommended method for CI/automation
   and when browser login is not available.

Examples:
  spin login                    # Login via browser (OAuth)
  spin login --token <api-key>  # Login with API key (recommended for CI)

Usage:
  spin login [flags]

Flags:
      --endpoint string   API endpoint URL (default: https://app.spinbox.dev)
  -h, --help              help for login
      --token string      API key or session token (create in dashboard: Settings > API Keys)

Global Flags:
      --config string    config file (default is $HOME/.spin/config.yaml)
  -o, --output string    text for a person, or json: one document of what the API answered, and no prose (default "text")
      --profile string   named profile to use (default "default")
```
